scope: Isolated local temporary server, synthetic users and temporary group; no production data
optimizationsApplied: O(1) indexed WebSocket token user lookup
large-group presence fanout capped at 512 members
identical group summaries reuse serialized JSON
identical WebSocket payloads reuse one encoded frame
cross-shard fanout batches 512 recipients per internal request
clients update from the realtime chat summary instead of reloading the whole chat list for every message
native TCP WebSocket load client with explicit unique source ports
conclusion: One isolated Node process accepted 50000 concurrent sockets
No message loss was observed from 10000 through 50000 concurrent recipients
10000 is the highest currently verified tier with P99 below 2 seconds
Fanout latency remains the limiting factor above 10000
Production still requires multi-cell soak and capacity evidence
